body.title: Implement resolveSecurityModelCandidate (pure, synchronous selection)
body.summary: function resolveSecurityModelCandidate(cfg: AnalyzeConfig, registry: ModelRegistry): SecurityModelCandidate. Resolves tiering.security (via parseSecurityModelPin's result already on cfg) or, if absent, the 'security.review' role's tier-default model; rejects immediately (status:'unavailable', no substitution) if malformed, unlisted, or failing securityPinMeetsFloor. Zero I/O, zero subprocess work.
acceptanceChecks: A valid, floor-eligible pin -> status:'candidate' with that (runner, model)
A malformed pin -> status:'unavailable' immediately, never falling through to the tier-default model
A valid but below-floor/unclassifiable pin -> status:'unavailable', never substituted
An absent pin falls through to the 'security.review' role's tier-default model as a normal candidate
An absent pin whose tier-default model is itself unlisted/below-floor -> status:'unavailable'
